name: Camera groups and sites
description: Organize cameras into site-scoped groups and subgroups, with a shared camera tree for navigation.
evidence: EVMS e97be6a: server/services/groupPolicy.js; EVMS_V1.1.0_REGRESSION_AUDIT.md §23; group persistence and assignment boundary checks.

name: Recording storage allocation
description: Choose a recording path, validate it on the recorder, and allocate the cameras that should use it.
limitation: Storage must be mounted and writable on the recorder. Recording requires an explicit operator action.
evidence: EVMS e97be6a: server/services/storageTargetManager.js; server/routes/storageTargets.js; recording acceptance in regression audit §16.

name: Playback and clip export
description: Review recorded footage and export a selected time range as a separate MP4 clip.
limitation: Requires available footage and camera access. Source recording remains unchanged.
evidence: EVMS e97be6a: server/routes/recordings.js; actual 5.96-second H264 export and authenticated download in regression audit §17.

name: User access management
description: Manage user accounts with role, site and camera permissions, plus authenticator MFA for guarded administration.
limitation: Privileged user changes require MFA and recent sign-in.
evidence: EVMS e97be6a: server/routes/auth.js; USER_CREATION_ROOT_CAUSE_REPORT.md real API/browser/database account lifecycle.
